newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hopes fade of firmer Estonian share market.
newsitem.headline: Hopes fade of firmer Estonian share market.

text.p: Hopes of a firmer market faded on the Estonian bourse on Monday after an active morning as stocks eased and trade slowed, leaving little hope for movement on the sluggish bourse on Tuesday, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 24.6 million kroons with the Talse 0.04 percent lower at 253.29.
"The number of investors active on the market is lower by about one third and the market is sluggish," one dealer said.
"It looked like the market was going to pick up in the morning, but it remained listless and it looks like this will carry over into tomorrow," he added.
Hoiupank was the most active with 7.2 million kroons changing hands for a small gain of 1.70 kroons to close at 131.25 kroons.
"There remains some general interest in the stock and this may have prompted the movement, but there is an overall shortage of good positive news," one dealer said.
Hansapank firmed slightly to close at 132.00 kroons, up 0.29 kroons after turning over 3.6 million kroons.
